description: This file defines a Python class 'StrandsAgentsProcessor' that integrates Strands Agents with Pipecat for handling conversational AI interactions, supporting both single agent and multi-agent graph workflows. It manages message processing, streaming responses, and metrics reporting.

classes.name: StrandsAgentsProcessor
classes.description: A processor class that integrates Strands Agents with Pipecat's frame pipeline, capable of handling both single agent and multi-agent graph workflows, with message processing, streaming, and metrics reporting.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the StrandsAgentsProcessor with optional agent, graph, and graph exit node, asserting correct configuration.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, extracts messages from context frames, and invokes agent or graph processing.

methods.name: _ainvoke
methods.description: Invokes the Strands agent or graph with provided text, streams responses, and updates metrics.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this processor supports metrics generation.

methods.name: _report_usage_metrics
methods.description: Reports token usage metrics based on agent or graph responses.
